image_prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 watercolor storybook illustration for a gentle Chinese bedtime story opening greeting. Use the attached image only as a strict character/style reference: same small cream-colored lop-eared rabbit Pipi, rounded plush-like proportions, calm kind eyes, navy blue nightcap with tiny golden stars, subtle warm watercolor paper texture. New composition: Pipi sits in a peaceful wooden bedroom at night, looks toward the viewer with a small welcoming smile and raises one paw to greet children before the story. Warm bedside lamp and a quiet moonlit window, simple uncluttered atmosphere. Character in upper two-thirds and lower third open/soft for subtitles. No slippers, shoes, books, story props, extra characters, text, letters, or watermark.
